customActions.name: Ship
customActions.command:
Commit all the changes, Bump the version (semver based on changes since last tag), commit, tag, and push. Do NOT create a GitHub release — CI handles that from the tag push. Show me the changelog for what's new. Before anything, run Typecheck @orchestra/desktop#typecheck: command (/home/runner/work/orchestra/orchestra/apps/desktop) /home/runner/.bun/bin/bun run typecheck, make sure there is no typechecks, if there is any fix , then proceed.  

also deploy the web app to vercel.

customActions.name: Install
customActions.command:
Prompt A ‚Äî what actually happened (works today, no setup)

Use this when a release builds on GitHub but the publish job fails (billing, or the job just dies), leaving a stuck Draft:

The v<X.Y.Z> release is stuck as a Draft ‚Äî GitHub built the assets but the
publish job never ran. Publish it locally, replicating release.yml's publish
job exactly. Don't skip the checksum reconcile step: each runner builds all
four artifacts and the slower job's uploads clobber the faster one's, so the
merged latest-mac.yml has wrong sha512s for one arch. Verify every asset with
apps/desktop/scripts/verify-latest-mac.rb before flipping the draft, and stop
and tell me if any check fails. The repo is private, so public download URLs
404 even when it worked ‚Äî verify via the authenticated gh api instead.

That's ~5 minutes and it's what I just ran. It still depends on GitHub for the build.

Prompt B ‚Äî genuinely no GitHub compute (needs one-time setup first)

This can't work until the signing credentials exist on your machine. Right now it would produce an unusable self-signed build.

One-time setup ‚Äî you have to do this part, from the values already in GitHub ‚Üí Settings ‚Üí Secrets:

- CSC_LINK (base64 Developer ID .p12) + CSC_KEY_PASSWORD
- APPLE_API_KEY (.p8 contents) + APPLE_API_KEY_ID + APPLE_API_ISSUER

Put them in apps/desktop/.env.release.local (gitignored ‚Äî not .env.local, which is git-tracked-adjacent and holds runtime secrets). Then:

Cut a fully local release, no GitHub Actions. Load the Apple signing creds from
apps/desktop/.env.release.local, bump the version, build and notarize both
arches locally (electron-builder --mac --arm64 and --x64), generate and
reconcile latest-mac.yml from the actual built bytes, verify with
verify-latest-mac.rb, then create the GitHub release and upload the assets with
gh. Confirm MAIN_VITE_DEVICE_SECRET and MAIN_VITE_UPDATER_GH_TOKEN are baked in
from .env.local before building. Stop if signing or notarization fails ‚Äî
do not publish a self-signed build.
